quick_skim.title: Vibe-Coded and Tuned: A State-of-the-Art SMT Solver for QF-LRA
quick_skim.abstract: This paper presents the SMT solver primo, which is fully vibe-coded and then parameter-tuned, achieving state-of-the-art results on linear real arithmetic (QF-LRA). The performance of primo is achieved by a systematic literature survey, repeated profiling, and parameter tuning. The resulting solver outperforms the winner of the QF-LRA track of SMT-COMP~2026. This confirms that vibe-coding of automated reasoning tools will enable us to make great strides in the future.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 自动化推理求解器的开发长期依赖人工编码与繁琐调参，难以快速达到竞赛级性能。本文提出完全由大语言模型氛围编码（vibe-coding）生成、随后进行系统参数调优的SMT求解器primo，面向线性实数算术（QF-LRA）。通过系统文献调研、反复性能剖析与参数调优，primo在SMT-COMP 2026的QF-LRA赛道超越冠军求解器。该工作表明借助LLM自动生成与调优求解器代码可显著加速推理工具研发，与LLM辅助求解器设计及参数调优主题高度相关。
